title: 第9章 不是说好的没靠山呢第10章 我许老实今天不当老实人了
content_zh:
很快，二人来到一处密室前，秦老敲了敲厚重的石板道：“大师人带来了。”
下一刻，石门缓缓上升。
二人随之走了进去。
许小凡第一眼就看见一个极大的炼丹炉。
第二眼才看见盘坐在炼丹炉前的一位留着两撇山羊胡的道袍中年。
这应该就是徐大师，一位炼丹师！
虽然没怎么出过门，但许小凡也曾听闻过。
炼丹师极其稀有，而武者修炼常靠丹药辅助，地位自然水涨船高。
于是许小凡也肃然起敬，“丹方大师已经鉴定过了吧，请问值多少金？”
徐大师摸着山羊胡，没有说话，而是上下打量着许小凡...
衣着破烂，模样狼狈，虽然长相俊逸，眉宇间却带着几分难以掩饰的忧愁。
妥了！
一看就是个没什么背景的小人物！
确定了这一点后，徐大师心中窃喜，面上却冷笑道：
“值多少金？你拿一张假丹方过来糊弄，没要你的命就不错了！”
他声音略带一丝尖锐，让人格外不舒服。
许小凡懵了！
几乎是一瞬间，他就想明白对方要干什么了。
白嫖！
这狗东西不想给钱！

这一而再再而三的，气的许小凡差点就想撸袖子开干！
然而就在这时，他眼前浮现出几行文字：
【您遭到了炼丹大师的欺辱，以下您有两个选择：
一：一雪前耻，将欺辱自己的人全部杀死，奖励‘随机战技’。
二：隐忍，兵不血刃的度过此次危机，奖励‘紫府境修为体验卡一张’。
神秘战技和体验卡二选一。
许小凡直接选择第二选项，这压根没有任何悬念！
紫府境对于他来说，是目前已知的最高境界！
一张紫府境体验卡，约等于一次保命机会！
这种诱惑是难以抵挡的！
这么一比，一张三品药方什么都不是！
下一刻，许小凡表现出一个卖假货被拆穿，无比惊恐的样子。
他声音发颤，支支吾吾道：“不...不会吧...看着不像假的...”
徐大师心中疑惑：这小子这么好糊弄？
不过他还是瞪着眼睛道：“我堂堂二品炼丹师，还能骗你？”
许小凡直接认错。
content_en:
Soon, the two came to a secret room. Mr. Qin knocked on the heavy stone slab and said, "Master has brought it."
The next moment, the stone gate slowly rose.
The two then walked in.
Xu Xiaofan saw a huge alchemy furnace at first sight.
At the second glance, he saw a middle-aged Taoist man with a goatee sitting cross-legged in front of the alchemy furnace.
This should be Master Xu, an alchemist!
Although Xu Xiaofan had never been out much, he had heard of it.
Alchemists are extremely rare, and warriors often rely on pills to help them practice, so their status naturally increases.
So Xu Xiaofan was also in awe, "Master Danfang has appraised it, right? How much gold is it worth?"
Master Xu touched his goatee and said nothing, but looked Xu Xiaofan up and down...
His clothes were in tatters and he looked miserable. Although he looked handsome, there was a hint of sadness in his eyebrows that was difficult to conceal.
That’s it!
At first glance, he looks like a little person with no background!
After confirming this, Master Xu was secretly happy in his heart, but sneered on his face:
"How much gold is it worth? If you bring a fake elixir recipe to fool me, it's not bad if it doesn't cost you your life!"
There was a hint of shrillness in his voice that made people feel particularly uncomfortable.
Xu Xiaofan was confused!
Almost instantly, he figured out what the other party was going to do.
Whoring for free!
This bitch doesn’t want money!
This happened again and again, and Xu Xiaofan was so angry that he almost wanted to roll up his sleeves and start doing it!
However, at this moment, a few lines of text appeared in front of his eyes:
[You have been insulted by the alchemy master. You have two choices:
One: To avenge one's shame, kill all those who insulted oneself, and be rewarded with 'random combat skills'.
Two: Be patient and survive this crisis without any bloodshed, and you will be rewarded with a 'Purple Mansion Realm Cultivation Experience Card'.
Choose between mysterious combat skills and experience cards.
Xu Xiaofan directly chose the second option, there was no suspense at all!
For him, the Purple Mansion Realm is the highest realm known so far!
A Zifu Realm experience card is equivalent to an opportunity to save your life!
This temptation is irresistible!
In such a comparison, a third-grade prescription is nothing!
The next moment, Xu Xiaofan looked extremely horrified that he was exposed for selling fake goods.
His voice trembled and he hesitated: "No...it can't be...it doesn't look fake..."
Master Xu was puzzled: Is this kid so easy to fool?
However, he still stared and said: "I am a second-grade alchemist, can I still lie to you?"
Xu Xiaofan directly admitted his mistake.
